items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions 'Ruth was always perfect' and asks about Duke Ellington's mother; Interviewee responds about Duke's relationship with his mother, but does not describe a personal relationship with Ruth.

ctx.x: Yeah, with the mother and the father and Duke, because anything his mother would say, that was it, because he was madly in love with his mother, which is wonderful.
